basic_info.description: Scenic Retreat, Flexible Home. Nestled in the sought-after Miraloma Park neighborhood, this charming and spacious home offers the perfect balance of serenity and city convenience. Enjoy a fabulous view of the city lights, providing an exceptional sense of calm and tranquility right from your own living room.  The exquisite floor plan is thoughtfully designed with spacious rooms and abundant windows, bathing every space in natural light. This home is in turnkey condition, featuring updated kitchen and baths.    In addition, there is also a large legal storage room offers versatile, multi-functional usageperfect for a home office, gym, or studio.    Step outside to a great private patio, ideal for entertaining or unwinding after a long day. The property also includes a 1-car parking garage with storage space.  Located with easy access to public transit and major freeways, and in close proximity to shopping, dining, and everyday lifestyle conveniences, this home offers both comfort and accessibility in one of San Francisco's most desirable communities.
